headline_marked: Job letters handed to [[families of movement victims]] by PM Tarique
headline: Job letters handed to families of movement victims by PM Tarique
summary: The Prime Minister provides employment opportunities to the families of those who lost their lives during the recent movements.
details: Chief Advisor Tarique Muhammad is providing job appointment letters to the families of those who were killed during the recent student-led movements.
This move is part of a government initiative to support the families of the victims who lost their loved ones during the protests.
The appointment letters were handed over in a a formal ceremony where the families were met by the government leadership.
The initiative aims to provide financial stability and security to the families of the victims as a form of compensation and recognition of their sacrifice.

headline_marked: 400 extortion complaints [[recorded by anonymous platform]] in three days
headline: 400 extortion complaints recorded by anonymous platform in three days
summary: A new digital tool allows citizens to report extortion incidents anonymously, revealing a high volume of complaints in a short period.
details: An anonymous reporting platform has recorded 400 extortion complaints within its first three days of operation.
The platform allows users to report incidents of extortion (known as 'chanda') and provides a way for citizens to safely disclose information without revealing their personal identity.
According to the reported data, these complaints highlight the widespread nature of extortion activities across various sectors.
The platform aims to facilitate the collection of evidence and information that can be used by law enforcement agencies to take action against extortionists.
Citing the platform's website, the platform intends to send relevant complaint data to relevant DC offices, SP offices, and other responsible authorities for further investigation.
This digital initiative represents a move towards using technology to fight crime and crime-related fear among the general public.
